Cleaning a telescope mirror is an essential part of maintaining its clarity and performance. Start by gently wiping the mirror with a soft, lint-free cloth to remove any dust or debris. Use a mild cleaning solution specifically designed for optical surfaces, and make sure to rinse it thoroughly with water. Avoid using abrasive materials or harsh chemicals that could scratch the mirror. After cleaning, allow the mirror to dry completely before using it again. Regular maintenance will ensure the telescope continues to provide clear and accurate views of the night sky.
